text: Vast and towering is Heaven, Sovereign of the Firmament, ever blazing, ever radiant, without beginning, without end.
Vast and towering is Heaven, Lord of the Azure Vault, boundless is the great sky, wherein it soars and wheels.
Vast and towering is Heaven, Master of the Boundless Expanse, drifting across the vast blue void, roaming to its farthest limit.
Vast and towering is Heaven, treading wind and driving fire; when it descends, its radiance eclipses sun and moon.
Vast and towering is Heaven, illuminating the great wilderness, accomplished in both letters and arms, its might beyond rival.
This province's climate will no longer inflict penalties on the player.
Upon completion of the building, Chaos will launch a simultaneous attack against both the building's location and the Great Bastion.
Passive Ability: All cavalry units gain [[col:yellow]]Strider[[/col]].
The Emperor's will burns bright as a torch, annihilating all wraiths and demons!

The Great Bastion has been destroyed. Though its structure may be restored through the material strength of Cathay, its power to ward off evil and impurity has been lost.\\nTo bring Cathay back to peace, one must journey to the Chaos Wastes at last, using the Celestial Tower as a conduit to channel the Dragon Emperor's might and rebuild the Great Bastion.
